description: Install the Agent Plugins bundle into GitHub Copilot CLI from a local path and confirm it lists as installed.
why: Plan item 4c's gate. Everything about the Copilot namespace is documentation-verified (VS Code's plugin doc) and CLI-unverified; only this install can settle it. On a machine without the CLI the scenario is SKIPPED with that reason — never green. First passed live 2026-09-26 on Copilot CLI 1.0.88. The R13 model-list probe that rode here until then called `copilot agent list`, which that build does not have; it moved to copilot-agent-frontmatter (tier 1), because loading a custom agent means running it, and that spends Copilot credits.

steps.why: docs.github.com (plugins-creating): `copilot plugin install ./my-plugin` installs from a local path. A non-zero exit is the finding — record its stderr.
The installed plugin must appear under the manifest name; if the CLI names installed plugins differently, this step's stdout is the evidence to update the scenario from.
